title: Tamsin and the Ember
author: Yara Pemberton
blurb: Rafael Ashgrove, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
